All 47 tests pass (37 new + 10 existing). Here's a summary of the edge cases now covered:

**Quotes:**
- Empty double/single quoted values (`""`, `''`)
- Mismatched quotes (not stripped)
- Nested quotes (`"it's"`, `'say "hello"'`)
- Single quote character as entire value
- Quotes in the middle of a value (not stripped)

**Escaped characters (documented as literal — no escape processing):**
- `\"` inside double quotes — backslash preserved
- `\'` inside single quotes — backslash preserved
- `\n`, `\t` — not interpreted as control characters
- Bare backslash value

**Keys:**
- Empty key (`=value`), bare equals (`=`)
- Dotted and hyphenated keys
- `export` prefix (becomes part of the key — documented behavior)

**Whitespace:**
- Leading/trailing whitespace on lines
- Tabs around equals
- Whitespace-only lines
- Spaces inside vs. around quoted values

**Comments:**
- Inline comments NOT stripped (documented behavior)
- Hash inside quoted values preserved
- Comment lines with equals signs skipped

**Values:**
- Multiple equals signs, special characters, unicode
- Duplicate keys (last wins)
- Windows `\r\n` line endings

**File I/O:**
- `load` errors on missing file
- `load_optional` reads existing files correctly
